answer: Place every new identity in a haven quarantine at the base of a graduated knoll: it can transact freely but earns nothing until it climbs tiered work checkpoints. Rewards vest glacier-slow, a thin slice per checkpoint, and the frozen history of each completed tier is published for auditors. A farm running fifty puppets must staff all fifty through every slow tier with real, distinct work while each payout trickles out over weeks. Climbing faster is impossible and buying a higher knoll is worthless, because the glacier only releases what verified effort has already earned.
